main.description: Served by the bidder's GuestControlPlane to a guest holding a workload identity token. Streams the requester-authored compute.events.guest.* payloads for that guest's contract, in order, after cursor.

cursor.description: The last seq the guest received; entries after it are replayed, then new ones streamed. Absent, the stream starts at the oldest entry kept.

record.description: The payload record value; its $type is a compute.events.guest.* NSID.
